newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DSC Communications upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DSC Communications upped.

text.p: UBS Securities said on Thursday it upgraded its rating on the shares of DSC Communications Corp to buy from hold, with a target of $30 per share by the end of the year.
-- Analyst Nikos Theodosopoulos said in a research note he raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.86 per share from $0.80 per share and his 1998 estimate to $1.45 per share from $1.30 per share.
-- He said he believes the company's switching business should improve in the second half of the year, which would enhance margins and earnings visibility.
